 Are 'DWTS' Alum Kym Johnson & Robert Herjavec Still Together?
 Alyssa Norwin Tue, October 20, 2026 at 2:04 PM UTC 5 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. DANCING WITH THE STARS, (from left): dance partners Kym Johnson, Robert Herjavec - Craig Sjodin / ©ABC / Courtesy Everett Collection Kym Johnson and Robert Herjavec met and fell in love while they were partners in Season 20 of Dancing With the Stars in 2015. The pair came in sixth place, but left the show with much more than a Mirrorball trophy. Johnson and Herjavec realized they wanted to spend the rest of their lives together and quickly married.
 Now, Johnson is returning to the show as a guest judge for Season 35's Dedication Night. But has her relationship with Herjavec withstood the last decade? Scroll down to learn more about their relationship, family, and more.
 Are Kym Johnson and Robert Herjavec still together?
 Yes, Johnson and Herjavec are still together. They celebrated their 10th wedding anniversary on July 31, 2016. "@robertherjavec You are the best thing in my life…. Happy 10th anniversary," Johnson wrote on Instagram .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In February 2026, Johnson and Herjavec opened up about their love story on Live with Kelly and Mark . Johnson revealed that Herjavec kept trying to ask her out during the season, but she wanted to maintain a professional relationship. Herjavec was persistent, and she had accepted initially, but she decided at the last minute not to go. "I was crushed," Herjavec admitted. The Shark Tank star didn't give up, and he kept asking Johnson out. Their first official date was at the vow renewal between two of Herjavec's friends.
 The businessman popped the question to Johnson in February 2016, less than one year after they first met. They wasted no time tying the knot, ultimately marrying in July 2016. "I enjoy every minute I spend with Kym. When I met her, I felt complete," Herjavec gushed at the time.
 On Live with Kelly and Mark , Herjavec confessed that he felt "so much pressure" at his wedding to Johnson because she had choreographed an elaborate dance for the two of them. "I wasn't nervous about getting married. I was nervous about the opening dance," he explained.
 View this post on Instagram
 A post shared by Kym Johnson-Herjavec (@kymherjavec5678) 
 In September 2026, Johnson paid tribute to Herjavec on his 64th birthday. "It's so easy to love and celebrate you @robertherjavec Happy birthday," she wrote on Instagram. In a 2024 interview , Johnson revealed that she and Herjavec currently split their time between Canada and her native Australia. They have a gorgeous lakeside home in Muskoka, Canada.
 What is Kym Johnson and Robert Herjavec's age difference?
 Johnson and Herjavec have a 14-year age difference. As of press time, she is 50 years old and he is 64 years old. When they met, they were 38 and 52, respectively.
 Do Kym Johnson and Robert Herjavec have children?
 Yes, Johnson and Herjavec are parents to twins Hudson and Haven, whom Johnson gave birth to in April 2018. She was 41 years old at the time.
 Advertisement Advertisement The twins were conceived via in vitro fertilization (IVF). "I had frozen my eggs when I was 35, thinking I was doing something that would help me in the future, but none of those eggs were healthy," Johnson previously shared . "We had been trying naturally for a while and having some trouble, so we did IVF. We actually put two embryos in, so we knew there was a chance we could have twins."
 What happened to Robert Herjavec's first wife?
 Before he was with Johnson, Herjavec was married to optometrist Diane Plese for more than two decades. They tied the knot in 1990 and separated in July 2014. Herjavec announced that he and Plese were divorcing in March 2015, just days before he made his DWTS debut. Their split was finalized in June 2016, one month before he and Johnson tied the knot.
 In 2019, a judge ruled that Herjavec had to pay Plese $125,000 a month in support, as well as a total of $25 million in assets, according to the Toronto Sun . In her judgment, the judge noted that Herjavec was "involved in an extramarital affair" in 2014.

 Herjavec dated Danielle Vasinova on and off from January 2014 to February 2015. In 2017, he sued her for extortion, claiming she tried to get him to pay millions of dollars amid false claims of sexual assault. The Shark Tank star also sued for intentional infliction of emotional distress and public disclosure of private facts, according to People . He only requested $1 in damages and an end to the alleged extortion.
 Advertisement Advertisement Vasinova fired back with a lawsuit of her home, claiming Herjavec raped her, which he denied, per TMZ . Both lawsuits were dismissed in 2018.
 Does Robert Herjavec have a relationship with his older children?
 With Plese, Herjavec shares three older children: daughters Caprice and Skye, and son Brendan.
 After Herjavec and Plese's split, he revealed that the kids wouldn't speak to him. "Everyone has their kryptonite," he told People . "For me, it was my kids. It took me to a place I never thought I would go."
 Herjavec said he even thought about ending his life when he hit rock bottom amid the separation and estrangement from his children. He has not given a recent update on where he and his three older children stand, so it's not clear where their relationship is at now.
